dependencyNote: Shared private-byte/curated-evidence helpers are provided by the separate evidence-operator commit and are not duplicated in this change.
verifiedBehavior: Private strict config pins each exact run and bundle digest; bounded public-curated verification excludes final fixtures, unknown tasks, experiment traces, candidate-only records and nonterminal runs.
External private regular files are required; symlinks, hardlinks, broad modes, URLs, in-project paths and oversized inputs reject.
HTTP mutations and event streams reject; host/origin controls remain loopback/same-origin and operator paths are omitted.
In-memory snapshots survive later bundle deletion, configuration/fixture changes and caller mutation of the returned safe manifest.
Downloads preserve exact verified JSON bytes, including historical version 2.0 evidence and its original commands.
Three-screen UI distinguishes recorded live and recorded mock from execution, hides archive mutation controls, preserves unknown usage and explains explicit private live-replay configuration.
Rendered checks cover keyboard task selection, mobile layout, literal patch markup, exact-byte downloads, reload and no archive mutations/event streams/browser errors.
A separate synthetic HTTP stub confirms the existing mock UI still exposes its mock launch action and submits mode mock.
developmentCorrections: Initial Host-header negative control used Node fetch, which did not transmit the supplied Host override. Replaced the test transport with node:http and verified the actual forbidden host is denied; not a server defect.
Initial typecheck rejected new error-code strings against the frozen contract enum. Reused existing method_not_allowed and infrastructure_error codes without changing shared contracts.
Initial browser selector matched both hidden comparison and visible evidence labels. Scoped the assertion to the evidence view; not a product rendering defect.
browserMethod: Shared Playwright MCP navigation was unavailable because its browser profile was already in use. Used a separate local pinned Playwright Chromium process; no shared browser was stopped.
independentReview: Requested from the separate evaluator; pending at author receipt creation. Any independent findings or completion are recorded separately.
limitations: All displayed live-shaped records and failed observations are invented unit metadata, not real inference or check execution.
Digests and curated input matching verify integrity/binding, not provider or billing authenticity, publication approval, human usability, or generalization.
No journal, ledger, model/sandbox factory, provider request, candidate execution, replay or remote/public deployment is performed by the archive.
Historical evidence with changed current public fixture metadata/source/policy fails startup. The archive does not relabel or rewrite historical bundles.
The default full product/Docker/browser suite was not rerun in this role. Root owns integrated runtime verification; apps/web/verify-browser.ts was untouched.

Same-UID trusted operator interference and copied private evidence containing unreviewed sensitive text are not solved by an integrity digest; only explicitly reviewed public-curated records should be configured.
